-- Nexus Obfuscated
local function _decode(s)
    local t = {}
    for i = 1, #s, 2 do
        table.insert(t, string.char(tonumber(s:sub(i, i+1), 16)))
    end
    return table.concat(t)
end

local function _check(s)
    local c = 0
    for i = 1, #s do
        c = (c + string.byte(s, i)) % 65535
    end
    return c == 22800
end

local function _run()
    local code = _decode("")
    if not _check(code) then
        error("Script tampered!")
        return
    end
    local fn, err = loadstring(code)
    if fn then
        pcall(fn)
    else
        warn("Error: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

_run()
